_comment: Generated by /bootstrap. Examples shown; replace with your own values.

topics.label: Example Tier 1 Topic
topics.description: Deep coverage: the topic you care most about

podcast._comment: If enabled, the morning cron generates a daily NotebookLM podcast from the digest + social-stream + wiki summaries. Requires `nlm` CLI installed and authenticated (see connectors/notebooklm/README.md). NotebookLM Plus/Pro recommended for the daily 20-overview cap.

twitter._comment: Configured only if sources.twitter is true. own_handle is your X handle (no @). ai_handles seeded by bootstrap; you edit later in connectors/twitter/config.json.

kurate._comment: Configured only if sources.kurate is true. categories[] uses arXiv category IDs (cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.RO, stat.ML, etc.).

reddit._comment: Configured only if sources.reddit is true. subreddits[] is edited later in connectors/reddit/config.json (per-sub sort/score/flair tuning). Bootstrap seeds a sensible AI-research default list.
